overview: A mobile-friendly football match draw app where an administrator registers teams and decides by hand which team plays which in each round.
features: Sign in with Internet Identity and administrator approval of who can join
Create, edit and delete teams with a name and a distinctive color
Create rounds and pick the home and away team of every match by hand
Warning when a team is picked twice in the same round
Mark a match as played and enter the final score
Match calendar grouped by round, readable on a phone
